title: The Holy Man and the Animals
text: Now there were four on the log, floating towards a bend in the river. Nearby a holy man was living humbly in a little hut. He just happened to be the Bodhisatta the Enlightenment Being. He had been born into a rich high class family in Kasi. When he had grown up, he had given up all his wealth and position, and had come to live by himself next to the river. It was the middle of the night when the holy man heard the cries of panic coming from the Evil Prince. He thought, "That sounds like a frightened human being. My loving kindness will not let me ignore him. I must save him." He ran down to the river and shouted. "Don't be afraid! I will save you!" Then he jumped into the rushing torrent, grabbed the log, and used his great strength to pull it to shore.

title: The Power of Habit
text: Every action we take is a vote for the type of person we wish to become. No single instance will transform your beliefs, but as the votes build up, so does the evidence of your new identity. This is one reason why meaningful change does not require radical change. Small habits can make a meaningful difference by providing evidence of a new identity. And if a change is meaningful, it actually is big. That is the paradox of making small improvements. Habits are the compound interest of self improvement. The same way that money multiplies through compound interest, the effects of your habits multiply as you repeat them.

title: A Short Story of Courage
text: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it. The brave person is not one who does not feel afraid, but one who conquers that fear. We must never confuse courage with the lack of fear. Every great achievement was once considered impossible by those who lacked the will to try. When you face a difficult situation, remember that the strength you need is already within you. Take one small step forward, and then another, and soon you will find that the mountain you feared has become a path beneath your feet.

title: Technology and the Future
text: Technology has transformed the way we live, work, and communicate with one another. From the invention of the wheel to the rise of artificial intelligence, human progress has always been driven by our desire to build better tools. Today, computers can perform calculations in seconds that would take a human a lifetime to complete. As we look to the future, we must use these powerful tools responsibly, ensuring that progress benefits everyone and not just a few. The choices we make now will shape the world for generations to come.

title: अच्छा व्यवहार (Good Behaviour)
text: अच्छा व्यवहार हर व्यक्ति के लिए बहुत जरूरी होता है। विनम्रता से बात करने से संबंध मजबूत होते हैं। दूसरों की मदद करना और धन्यवाद कहना अच्छी आदत है। अच्छा व्यवहार समाज में सम्मान दिलाता है और जीवन को सरल बनाता है।

title: परिश्रम का महत्व (Unicode)
text: परिश्रम ही सफलता की कुंजी है। जो व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन मेहनत करता है, वह अपने जीवन में अवश्य आगे बढ़ता है। आलस्य मनुष्य का सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है। हमें समय का सदुपयोग करना चाहिए और अपने लक्ष्य की ओर निरंतर बढ़ते रहना चाहिए।

title: हमारा देश भारत (Unicode)
text: भारत एक महान देश है। यहाँ अनेक भाषाएँ बोली जाती हैं और विभिन्न धर्मों के लोग मिलजुल कर रहते हैं। हमारे देश की संस्कृति बहुत प्राचीन और समृद्ध है। हमें अपने देश पर गर्व होना चाहिए और इसकी एकता को बनाए रखना चाहिए।
